steps.title: Charge
steps.imageAlt: G Pen Melt USB-C charging port

bullets.text: Plug **any USB-C cable** into the charging port on the bottom.
Give it a full charge before first use — takes about **1 hour**.
The LED blinks **8 times** when the battery is low.

note.text: **Always ready:** Melt supports pass-through charging — you can use it while it's plugged in. USB-C cable not included.

steps.title: Power On & Scoop
steps.imageAlt: G Pen Melt ceramic tip and button

bullets.text: **Click 5 times** quickly to power on. The LED lights to confirm.
**Touch the tip** to your concentrate to scoop up a small amount.
Device **auto-shuts off** after 10 minutes of inactivity.
Click 5 times again to power off.
**Hold the button** to heat the ceramic tip — it heats for up to **5 seconds** per hold.
Let your concentrate **melt cleanly** into your rig, bowl, or device.
Works with bangers, e-rigs, and G Pen devices like the Micro II, Micro+, Connect, and Hyer.

press.sub: Hold to heat, release to stop — 150 °C / 302 °F

steps.title: Clean
steps.imageAlt: Cleaning the G Pen Melt tip with a cotton swab

bullets.text: Clean the **blade** and **plastic housing** by wiping them with a **clean cloth**.
Clean the **plastic connection points** on the cap and the base of the blade.
Do **not** soak or submerge the device.
Regular cleaning keeps the tip performing at its best.

specs.label: In the box
specs.value: Melt hot knife, protective travel cap

faq.question: Nothing happens when I press the button
faq.answer: Press the button five times quickly to power on. The LED will light up to confirm. If it still doesn't respond, charge the device and try again.

faq.question: How do I use the Melt?
faq.answer: Power it on (5× click), touch the ceramic tip to your concentrate to scoop it up, hold the button to heat, and let it melt cleanly into your device.

faq.question: Does the Melt have variable heat?
faq.answer: No — the Melt uses a precisely tuned heating element optimized for smooth, controlled melting without burning. No settings to adjust.

faq.question: Can I use Melt while it's charging?
faq.answer: Yes. The Melt supports USB-C pass-through charging — plug it in and keep using it without waiting.

faq.question: Is the Melt safe for travel?
faq.answer: Yes. Its compact size (3.94" tall) and the included protective travel cap make it easy to carry. The 5× click lock prevents accidental activation.

faq.question: What does the warranty cover?
faq.answer: The Melt includes a 90-day limited warranty covering electronics. It does not cover physical damage. Register your device and contact support with your order details.
